name: TTB — Processing
sourceNotes: Mapped from the user-provided form edition. Blank quantities remain unknown; enter zero explicitly where appropriate. Shaded cells are unavailable. No business identities, source quantities, signatures, or sample reporting periods are included. Approval in this application does not sign the official form.

sections.title: Plant and reporting period
sections.description: Use the plant identity and reporting month for this processing report.

sections.title: Blank-line descriptions
sections.description: Identify the transactions used on blank lines 21–23 and 41–43, and the kind of spirit used on blank line 66.

sections.title: Part I — Bulk ingredients
sections.description: Both wine and spirits are reported in proof gallons. Line 8 totals lines 1–7; line 26 totals lines 9–25. Only the unshaded cells on the source form are available. Each column is checked for line 8 equaling line 26.

sections.title: Part IV — Processing of beverage (nonindustrial use) spirits
sections.description: Columns (b) and (c) use whole proof gallons; columns (d), (e), and (f) use whole wine gallons. Enter whole numbers in this part. Each line 67 total sums only its own column, including all lettered sublines. No proof-to-wine conversion is assumed. Consult the source form footnotes for the product categories and which dumped or imported spirits belong in each column.
